headline: Anthropic has opened an office in Singapore and signed an agreement with the government on AI safety cooperation.
score_reason: Kept at pool score: official agreement, but a memorandum with no binding detail.
importance_line: It links a leading AI lab to Singapore's safety institute and incident-sharing, which matters to the government and the company, though a memorandum of understanding sets no binding duties.
summary: CNA reports that Anthropic co-founder Benjamin Mann and Chng Kai Fong, permanent secretary of Singapore's digital development ministry, signed a memorandum of understanding covering AI safety, model evaluation, responsible adoption and incident response, as Anthropic opened its Singapore office. It comes as Senior Minister K Shanmugam said Singapore wants "full transparency immediately" from major tech firms when incidents happen; Anthropic did not say how large its Singapore team is.
